transcript: We've somehow reached the end of the 2025, 2026 Broadway season, and that means another opening, another show every night. There really is nothing like an opening night. And I was invited to join beaches at theirs. I took a whole pictures on the red carpet and got to people watch. It's always so much fun. And I love to go to opening just so I can give so much energy and love to these actors. They spent so many weeks and months and sometimes years working on these roles, and you only get one Broadway opening night. There are so many kids in the show, and they all are so cute. And Jessica Vosk is just on real. I really cannot believe this is her first time ever originating a role. My second opening night of the week was Joe Turner come and gone. The weather was unfortunately horrendous, so I had my little bond and try to keep my hair and makeup nice, because this opening night was black tie, formal, and everyone looked so good. I'm talking men in tuxes, women in full gowns. I was invited by $7 wine, and it was really an honor. I was in awe. This was an August Wilson play I had never seen before, and I just really liked it. And then after the show, we headed to the after party. It was at the Brian Park girl. And again, the weather was terrible, but the vibes were very good. There was great food, and there was great drinks, and, again, great people watching. I was very much aware I was a guest in the space, so I didn't really talk to anyone, but I very much enjoyed seeing them. And the very last show of the season to open was The Lost Boys, and they actually put opening tickets on sale, which some shows just don't do, but we decided to jump and buy them, and I'm so glad we did. I saw the show, like, a few weeks ago in previous, and it just felt so different. Everyone has found their characters. Everything just feels so sharp. We sat in the front row to the balcony, all the way to the side, and I would highly recommend. It was the tiniest, tiniest bit obstructed, but, like, really, I felt like I saw everything, and the crowd was so loud. Everyone was giving them so much love. It was just the perfect way to end this season. And with that, the 25 26 season is over, and Tony Award season officially begins. I actually can't believe it.
